note: WHO recommends sun protection at UV Index 3 or higher.
context: Higher UV can harm skin and eyes sooner. Time outdoors also matters.

levels.label: Low UV
actions: Most people need no extra sun protection under normal conditions.
Bright surfaces, especially fresh snow, can reflect UV.

levels.label: Protection recommended
actions: Seek shade around midday. Cover exposed skin and wear a wide-brimmed hat and UV-protective sunglasses.
Use broad-spectrum SPF 30+ sunscreen on uncovered skin. Reapply at least every two hours, sooner after swimming or sweating.

levels.label: Extra protection
actions: Limit direct sun around midday when possible and seek shade.
Keep the clothing, hat, sunglasses, and sunscreen steps above in place.
